# AIPages.tech — Brand Identity Guidelines

Welcome to the official brand asset package for **AIPages.tech** ("Yellow Pages for AI Agents"). This guide outlines the core design specifications, terminal iconography, color codes, typography hierarchy, and clear space rules.

---

## 1. Asset Inventory

All vector assets are pure standalone SVGs:

| File | Theme | Usage |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `aipages-logo-horizontal-light.svg` | Light | Website navigation header, investor decks, white documents |
| `aipages-logo-horizontal-dark.svg` | Dark | Dark mode web apps, code documentation, video watermarks |
| `aipages-logo-stacked-light.svg` | Light | Centered headers, splash screens, letterheads |
| `aipages-logo-stacked-dark.svg` | Dark | Centered dark headers, banner graphics |
| `aipages-terminal-icon-dark.svg` | Dark | 512×512 Squircle App Icon & social media avatar (X, LinkedIn, GitHub) |
| `aipages-favicon.svg` | Responsive | 64×64 / 32×32 / 16×16 browser tab favicon |
| `aipages-logo-monochrome-black.svg` | Mono | Single-ink black print, laser engraving, stamps, invoices |
| `aipages-logo-monochrome-white.svg` | Mono | Single-ink white print, dark swag/hoodie embroidery |

## 3. Typography Hierarchy

### Main Brandmark (`AIPages`)
- **Font Family**: Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter Tight
- **Weight**: 900 (Black)
- **Letter Spacing**: `-0.025em` (`-1.5px`)

### Domain Extension (`.tech`)
- **Font Family**: Plus Jakarta Sans
- **Weight**: 700 (Bold)
- **Size**: ~70% of the main brandmark cap-height in Syntax Slate (`#64748B` / `#94A3B8`)

### Primary Subtitle (`THE AI AGENT DIRECTORY`)
- **Font Family**: Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter
- **Weight**: 800 (ExtraBold)
- **Letter Spacing**: `0.4em` (`7px` tracking)
- **Casing**: ALL CAPS

### Technical Tagline (`INDEX / TOOLS / PROMPTS / RUNTIMES`)
- **Font Family**: JetBrains Mono / SF Mono / Courier New
- **Weight**: 600 (SemiBold)
- **Letter Spacing**: `0.15em` (`2px` tracking)
- **Separators**: Slashes (`/`)

---

## 4. Clear Space & Proportions

Maintain a minimum exclusion perimeter ($X$) around the logo equal to the cap-height of the capital **`A`**. No text, badges, or edges may intrude within this zone.
